BiblicalUsage: Adoniram, son of Abda, was over the levy — the forced labour — under Solomon, and later under Rehoboam. He organised the thirty thousand men sent to Lebanon in monthly shifts to cut timber for the temple, and he was still over the tribute when the kingdom split.
TheologicalSignificance: There is no teaching in this man's name, only a career that ended badly. I take the warning plainly: Adoniram served two kings faithfully and was killed by the people he had taxed, and the kingdom that used him could not save him.
RelatedPeople: Adoniram, Officer of Solomon; King Solomon; Rehoboam
